description: appNovi is a software designed to provide organizations with visibility into hybrid and multi-cloud environments by mapping network topology and dependencies. The software enables users to analyze and visualize network traffic flows, discover assets, andtrack application dependencies. appNovi supports incident response, vulnerability management, and segmentation projects by delivering insights into relationships between applications, workloads, and network infrastructure. It is equipped with features that facilitate network modeling, risk identification, and policy planning, aiming to help organizations optimize network security posture and streamline IT operations.
